step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features seven AWS nodes: API Gateway receiving incoming SIP call metadata, two Lambda functions (one for custom authorization and one for VeraCall logic), DynamoDB for lookup, SageMaker for fraud prediction, and SQS with S3 for data persistence and model training. Physical green arrows indicate the request flow and data persistence path.
